hypothesis_1_uniform_emotion_prior.evidence: Channels 5 through 10 (angry, disgust, fear, happy, sad, surprise) are identically constant 0.0 (std = 0.0000). Channel 11 (neutral) is constant 1.0 (mean = 0.9975, drops to 0 only during lost face/blank frames). No uniform 1/7 prior exists.

hypothesis_2_constant_zero_channels.claim: Some channels in the 32-D vector may be constant or zero.
hypothesis_2_constant_zero_channels.evidence: 14 of the 32 channels are degenerate or constant: Channels 5-10 (emotions) are constant 0.0; Channels 24-31 (reserved padding) are identically constant 0.0; Channels 19-20 (EAR/MAR) are fixed constant fallback 0.3000 due to missing OpenSeeFace.

hypothesis_3_posture_scb_checkpoint_abse.claim: A posture-SCB checkpoint may be absent.
hypothesis_3_posture_scb_checkpoint_abse.evidence: checkpoints/scb_yolo.pt (74.8 MB) DOES exist and runs active YOLOv7 inference for student behavior. However, checkpoints/posture_scb.pt (the MLP posture classifier) is MISSING. PostureExtractor falls back to geometric_posture(keypoints), which is blended 50/50 with scb_yolo.pt detections.

hypothesis_4_keypoint_confidence_disprop.evidence: In Clip 1100042026, upper-body keypoint confidence dropped below normal. Because the production model checkpoint classroom_manual_binary_model_v2_clean.pt incorporates conservative classroom safety rubrics that penalize low keypoint observability (Channel 23), the continuous score collapsed to 2.96 (P(HIGH) = 0.0296), producing a Class 0 prediction. In Clip 1100042023 of the same student where keypoints were confident, P(HIGH) was 0.9996. The production model's '50% recall' was an artifact of 1 out of 2 clips being penalized by keypoint confidence.

investigation_historical_test_discrepanc.claim: Why did historical public-test evaluation use 2 subjects and 148 clips while the official manifest lists 21 subjects and 1,784 clips?
investigation_historical_test_discrepanc.evidence: The historical experiments (Phase 7 and Phase 8) evaluated on fusion_daisee_v3_hardened.npz, which was a 750-clip development subset derived from fusion_daisee.npz. This subset contained only 12 subjects (8 Train, 2 Val, 2 Test: 110001 and 110004). The full 8,986-clip DAiSEE dataset (113 subjects) was never extracted until the Phase 6 rebuild (now 31.16% extracted in task-709).
